text:
maya: heads-up: nightly gpu CI (h100-warmup) just turned red on job 4567, flaky pagefault during warmup. see job: <https://ci.redwood/jobs/4567|CI job 4567>

sam: thanks — can you paste the failing log snippet?

maya: sure, tail of runner log:```
[2026-04-02T03:12:11Z] kernel_launch failed: invalid device memory access (pagefault)
Backtrace: launch_kernel+0x1f3
  at /workspace/runtime/launch.cu:214
CUDA driver 545.85 vs runtime 545.90 detected
```

zev: oof, driver mismatch + pagefault. likely a driver/runtime skew. which image was used?

maya: image: gpu-nightly:2026-04-01-compat. noted the CI matrix pulled node with driver 545.85 (older). most runs use 545.90.

lina: ops reported a one-off node that didn't update during the driver rollout last night. I've cordoned it (node-gpu-17) and draining now.

sam: can we rerun the failed shard on a known-good node before bisecting? if it passes we avoid a long bisect.

maya: requeued the job -> <https://ci.redwood/jobs/4567/retry|retry link> just now. cc @ci-bot for rerun diagnostics.

ci-bot: rerun started on node-gpu-3 (driver 545.90). running warmup shard 9/12. tailing logs...

zev: if rerun still fails, capture cupti/kern logs and try forcing CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and single-threaded warmup to reduce interleaving noise. also consider adding --no-cuda-jit to test.

maya: rerun completed — passed on node-gpu-3. so looks environmental.

sam: good. lina — can you add node-gpu-17 to the maintenance list and run the driver upgrade? also add a CI probe that alerts if driver/runtime mismatch > 0.

lina: on it. creating ticket: RED-ops-1724 and will patch the node tonight. adding probe to ops-checks.

maya: leaving a note in the job: "transient node with old driver; rerun passed on good node" — marking as flaky caused by infra.

sam: should we annotate the nightly matrix so we skip node-gpu-17 until patched?

lina: cordoned, and I've set node affinity tags so CI won't schedule warmup-heavy jobs there until upgrade complete.

zev: thanks all. action items: (1) lina upgrades driver + run warmup smoke on patched node, (2) sam/ops add probe for driver/runtime skew, (3) maya monitors next 3 nightlies for recurrence.

maya: ack. will follow up if it reappears. :thumbsup:
